notes: All 82 ABI functions reviewed (getters, role/pause functions, setters, delegate/repay/requestWithdraw/claim/finalize read; liquidationCall (348 lines) and the utilizer functions by structure). Source loops: finalizeDelegatorWithdrawalRequest's request loop (2334, 'while idx < _38' with break), clearUtilizerInterest (2076), _deleteRequestId inlined in claim (929) and StringsUpgradeable.toHexString in each onlyRole failure path (18 copies, the role-0 copy specialised to writing '0' digits): all whiles, no implicit loop left. finalize's struct copy, the re-reads of stor225[idx] before the external call and the cToken bookkeeping match the source. Many public variables are storNNN because their getters are not in the signature database (normal).
summary: Faithful and readable: every loop is a clear while; only small simplifications are missed (an implied bounds check in toHexString, distributed interest products, struct fields read back from memory).
